utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning all, you alright? Let's get cracking, Tuesday stand-up. Quick one if we can.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning everyone.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah morning. Bit less freezing today, thank God.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Mm, give it an hour.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, any immediate issues from night shift before we go round?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Only same old really, still waiting on parts for the boiler safety valve, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, parked then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And, uh, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the IM1, so that's still hanging.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I've chased them once already, I'll keep prodding, but yeah that's not moving this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine. Sarah, anything from production side?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Only that the shutdown on the GT2 bearing is cancelled now, production need it running, so don't plan round that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, cancelled, noted.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: On the done stuff, I tested the Site Water System yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, cheers Jamie.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And just so nobody doubles up, I already swapped the filter on the line 3 screw yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ah, nice one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Also already swapped the filter on the turbine one compressor yesterday, so that's off the list as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Lovely.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I had a walk round after that outage, heard a slight rattle from the fire alarm panel, nothing to action yet, just keeping an ear on it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, monitor only then.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And same sort of thing, heard a slight rattle from the line 1 hydraulics, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Line 1 always likes a bit of drama.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It does, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Speaking of drama, who's baking for the charity bake sale on Friday then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Not me, after last year. Mine came back untouched, honestly rude.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Was that the rock-hard brownies?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: They were meant to be flapjacks, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'd still eat them. Charity bake sale on Friday, I'm just saying, don't all bring shop-bought and pretend.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, Bake Off later, maintenance now. Jamie, can you check the guarding on the outfeed conveyor today at 2pm, top priority please?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, I can check the guarding on the outfeed conveyor today at 2pm. Top priority please, got it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And while I've got you, Jamie Brennan, can you take vibration readings on the GT1 compressor by Thursday? No rush, just want a baseline.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah that's fine, I'll take vibration readings on the GT1 compressor by Thursday. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got the meter booked out this afternoon anyway.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Perfect.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fire panel - two bits there. We need to run a function test on the fire panel first thing tomorrow, no rush. Anyone taking that?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Not me tomorrow first thing, I've got calibrations stacked.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'm tied up with line work in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I won't get near it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got stores delivery in.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Alright, so run a function test on the fire panel first thing tomorrow, no rush, but nobody's picked it up yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Leave it visible then, maybe afternoon if something frees, but nobody commit now.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine. Separate to that, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Priya, what are you on today?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Main one, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the line 3 barrel today at 2pm, normal priority. That needs doing before we touch it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah that's the right order.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll send the shift handover report round as well, no rush, just after I've cleaned up the notes.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good stuff.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: On ops side, I'll swap the filter on the Cooling Tower today, no rush. Better I just get that out the way.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You sure? I can help if you need a hand later.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Should be alright, mate, it's only the access that's annoying.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything else safety-wise before we move on?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nothing new from me. Just the bake sale risk assessment, loads of sugar.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: High hazard, that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus on CHP, other than the waiting game?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, plant ran alright overnight. A couple of nuisance alarms but they cleared. Nothing I'm asking for today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just on the fire panel thing, the slight rattle I mentioned from the fire alarm panel, I'm not linking it to a fault, just mentioning it in case anyone hears worse.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, observation only.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same with the turbine one compressor filter - that's already swapped, so if anyone's got old paperwork floating around, bin it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll clear the paper copy in stores.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can we just recap the timed items?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. Jamie is to check the guarding on the outfeed conveyor today at 2pm, top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Priya is to sort the permit to work and isolation for the line 3 barrel today at 2pm, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Jamie Brennan is to take vibration readings on the GT1 compressor by Thursday, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Callum will swap the filter on the Cooling Tower today, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire panel on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And run a function test on the fire panel first thing tomorrow, no rush, still unowned for now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: If I get a gap later today I'll shout, but don't put me on it now.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, not assigning it, just noting it needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Anything from stores apart from your glamorous guarding inspection?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Ha. Just deliveries and chasing PO numbers. Nothing else for the floor.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll get the handover report round before lunch if I can, but like I said, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Seriously though, Friday, charity bake sale - if someone brings sausage rolls that still counts, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's not baking, Olumide.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Depends if he burns them first.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, enough. If nothing else, let's go. Shout me if the fire panel test gets an owner later.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks.
